free_tier.stated: 3 TB / 5 TB / 10 TB / 20 TB / 30 TB tiers under Profi. 3 TB is the value tier: 990 ₽/mo list, 495 ₽/mo when paid annually (50 % annual discount is the steady state, not a short promo. The crossed-out 990 ₽ is the monthly rate). Upload per file: 100 GB. Monthly upload ceiling: 3× your Disk size.

egress.terms: FREE and explicitly unlimited: the plan comparison table states «Неограниченное скачивание по публичным ссылкам» (unlimited downloading via public links) and «Неограниченный доступ по вашим публичным ссылкам». No per-GB egress line exists anywhere in Yandex 360 consumer pricing. You cannot buy extra traffic because none is metered.

record.tooling: WebDAV endpoint live: `curl https://webdav.yandex.ru/` -> HTTP 302 to auth (expected; the mount is up). rclone `yandex` backend, rclone `webdav` with an app password, alist/OpenList `yandex` driver, official REST Disk API at cloud-api.yandex.net, plus the desktop client for Linux/Windows/macOS.
record.chaining: Cannot be pooled: one Yandex ID = one Disk. But the Family plan gives 1 TB to each of up to 8 members on one subscription (250 ₽/mo annual ≈ $3.03/TB), which is the cheapest legitimate multiplication path of the storage providers compared. Profi and Family can be stacked. Yandex's own FAQ says the Disk volume sums across two plans on one account.
record.limits_note: Upload traffic is bounded by terms stating monthly upload limits up to three times disk capacity (9 TB per month upload limit on a 3 TB plan). Per-object upload cap is 100 GB on Profi tiers. Public shared-link downloads are unthrottled and served directly from Yandex edge infrastructure.
record.reliability_note: Two real risks. (1) PRICE DISCRIMINATION IS DOCUMENTED AND MEASURABLE: the same page carries a «Оплата картой другой страны» (payment by a foreign card) block that routes to a separate tariff sheet, and the USD sheet at 360.yandex.com/premium-plans publishes $12.50/mo for 3 TB Pro versus 495 ₽ (~$5.99) on the RUB sheet. A 2.09× markup for a foreign card. Budget the USD number, not the rouble one. (2) Non-payment locks access progressively and then fully at 44 days (yandex.ru/support/disk/enlarge/disk-space.html). So this is not a set-and-forget archive unless the card keeps working.

free_tier.stated: 5 GB by default for users without a plan: 'По умолчанию пользователям без тарифа доступно 5 ГБ места в хранилище'. Photo/video 'unlimited' auto-upload is a plan feature only. Without a Yandex 360 plan, mobile uploads count against the 5 GB.

egress.terms: No egress fee, but the free tier just lost desktop sync entirely.

record.tooling: WebDAV + REST API + rclone backend exist, which is why this matters despite the quota.
record.chaining: Free tier provides 5 GB storage per registered account. Unlimited photo storage features require paid subscription plans.
record.limits_note: 5 GB total shared with Mail. As of 2026-06-03, desktop sync for Windows/macOS requires a paid subscription. Free users keep only local files in the client.
record.reliability_note: This is the round's clearest negative finding: Yandex removed free desktop synchronisation in June 2026 citing 'files of large volume' load, and the 'unlimited photo auto-upload' that used to be a free loophole now requires a Yandex 360 tariff. Kommersant frames it as the first radical free-tier cut of its kind in Russia.
